name: Additiononal Information 13
definition: Restrictions, remarks or notes that may be applied to an account or investment plan.

Limitation.name: Limitation
Limitation.definition: Restrictions and/or limitations on the account or party.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information such as remarks or notes that must be conveyed about the account management activity or party.

AccountValidation.name: Account Validation
AccountValidation.definition: Information or instructions for the by-passing of validations in the account registration process.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type or identification of the remark, note, limitation or restriction.

Regulator.name: Regulator
Regulator.definition: Regulator that may have to be informed about the remark, note, limitation or restriction.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the remark, note, limitation or restriction.
